summary: The started test checks whether an async task has started (started key equals 1); it works on normal tasks but warns.
questions: How do I check if an async task has started?
Can I use started on a non-async task?

answer_card.title: started test (async)
answer_card.answer_md: `result is started` is true when an async result has `started` set (value `1`). Works on non-async tasks with a warning.
